title: Rome Lasted Until 1453
sentences: The Roman Empire didn't end in 476.
Half of it lasted almost another thousand years.
That year, the last emperor in the West was deposed.
But the eastern half, ruled from Constantinople, carried on.
Its people called themselves Romans, and its rulers were emperors of the Romans.
It lasted until May 29, 1453, when the Ottomans took the city.
That's nine hundred and seventy-seven more years.
Follow for more from the fall of Constantinople.
caption:
